title: feat(compound): auto-compound learning loop (zero-LLM capture + inert weekly synthesis)
body_excerpt:
Move 4 from the compound-engineering session, right-sized for frugality.

## What
- **compound-capture.yml** (ACTIVE, $0) — on every implementation-PR merge, appends one JSONL line to a dedicated long-lived `compound-queue` branch. No LLM, never writes `main`, no PR-pile.
- **compound-synthesize.yml** (INERT) — `workflow_dispatch` only; `schedule:` commented. Reads the queue; **exits 0 with no model call if empty**. Otherwise one `anthropic/claude-sonnet-4` call (copied from observation-loop, same `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` secret) drafts `docs/solutions/<category>/*.md`, opens **one** PR, truncates the queue.
- 2 helper scripts + 2 real (non-dry-run) tests: JSONL correctness, body truncation, null-issue, category allow-list, slug path-traversal stripping.

## Cost
Capture = $0. Synthesis ≤1 mod

title: fix(pipeline): box spec writer — validator-contract sections + branch rooted at origin/main
body_excerpt:
## Problem
Seed convergence frozen (pulse 2026-06-09): wgmesh spec-auto-approve rejects 6/7 box-authored spec PRs.
Two contract violations:
1. **Wrong sections** — recipe `wgmesh-triage-spec.yaml` instructed `Summary/Context/Requirements/...`; wgmesh validator requires literal `## Classification`, `## Problem Analysis`, `## Proposed Approach` (+ actionable classification value on the line after the heading). Triple drift: recipe vs `evals/spec_parity.py` (correct) vs `evals/eval_spec.py` (a third variant) — nothing tied the recipe to the parity contract.
2. **Spec bundling** — `_prepare_spec_branch` did `checkout -B` from current HEAD of the shared clone, so each new spec branch inherited prior spec branches' commits (wgmesh #691 bundled 4 spec files).

## Fix
- Recipe prompt: exact valida
